title: Grateful Dead Live at Baltimore Civic Center on 1982-04-19

ai_review.summary: Matrix mix (60% SBD/40% AUD) sounds excellent and the show is a smoking 1982 Baltimore performance with standout second‑set sequences.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this April 19 1982 Baltimore concert, calling it one of the band’s best of the year. The matrix recording – praised as the “best‑sounding source” – captures Jerry’s vocal and guitar brilliance, high‑energy playing from Bob and Brent, and a thunderous second set that includes Feel Like A Stranger → Franklin's Tower → Estimated Prophet → Terrapin Station among other classics.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed 5‑star reviews highlight an exceptional performance and a top‑quality matrix mix, yielding an almost perfect combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix of ~60% soundboard and ~40% audience provides crisp, balanced audio; reviewers describe it as the best‑sounding source for this concert with no noted flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set flows seamlessly through a string of high‑impact songs, with the jam sequence (Feel Like A Stranger → Franklin's Tower → Estimated Prophet → Terrapin Station) highlighted as especially tight and thrilling.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Voice described as sounding “as good as ever” and guitar work on They Love Each Other and Peggy‑O praised as amazing.
band_member_comments.Phil: "More nitrous!" – indicates powerful, high‑energy bass playing.
band_member_comments.Bob: "Bobby ... in high‑gear" – strong rhythm guitar/vocal performance noted.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent (keyboardist) is said to be “in high‑gear”, highlighting excellent keyboard work.
